title: Circuit & Explosive Pyramid
description: 3-round strength-cardio circuit followed by a jump squat pyramid across 9 explosive steps

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Fast lateral shuffles, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Sumo squats
exercises.instructions: Feet very wide apart, toes pointing outward

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on the edge, elbows back, lower to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: On your forearms, body perfectly aligned, brace your core

exercises.name: Lateral lunges
exercises.instructions: Big step to the side, bend one leg, keep the other straight

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift the shoulders, brace your abs

exercises.name: Tuck jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump while bringing your knees to your chest

exercises.name: Jump squats
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a jump, absorb the landing

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, bring the foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
